title: Mechanisms of human mitochondrial leaderless mRNA translation initiation
task: Elucidate mechanisms of human mitochondrial translation initiation on leaderless mRNAs
key_results: Two parallel initiation pathways identified: sequential 28S + 39S recruitment and direct 55S monosome loading; monosome pathway tolerates non-formylated Met-tRNA and is suppressed by mtIF3
comments: Single-molecule fluorescence combined with cryo-EM provides powerful mechanistic insight, though the functional advantage of dual pathways remains unclear.

Cryo-EM structural analysis
Biochemical reconstitution assay

hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 28S loads first, followed by 39S recruitment

hypotheses.hypothesis: Alternative direct monosome loading pathway exists
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; preassembled 55S can load directly onto mRNA

title: Propagation of electrical spike trains in substrates colonised by oyster fungi
task: Characterize electrical signal propagation through fungal mycelial networks
key_results: Slow electrical spikes (tens of seconds to minutes) propagate with median velocity ~0.7 cm/min (~40 cm/h) along mycelial network; lead-lag ordering and shuffling controls confirm biological origin
comments: Elegant long-term multi-channel electrophysiology reveals ionic wave dynamics, but mechanistic link to fungal physiology or information processing remains speculative.

Temporal sequence analysis

hypotheses.hypothesis: Signals propagate via ionic waves through mycelium

title: Trisomy 8 alters chromatin conformations and activates Y chromosome genes in stem cells to drive a pre-leukemic state

key_results: Trisomy 8 alters chromatin accessibility and conformations in HSCs; trisomy 8 activates Y chromosome genes including Uty/Kdm6c; Uty demethylates H3K27me3 and activates PRC2-target and Runx1-target genes; Runx1 deletion mitigates trisomy 8 HSC impaired self-renewal
comments: The discovery that Y chromosome gene activation (Uty) drives trisomy 8 leukemogenesis is novel, though the mechanistic connection between aneuploidy-induced chromatin changes and Uty activation requires further elucidation.

title: RIPK3 sequentially recruits MLKL and RIPK1 to induce PANoptosis and chemokine production

comments: The model of RIPK3 as a multimolecular integrator platform is conceptually elegant and explains crosstalk between necroptosis, apoptosis, and pyroptosis, though the structural basis for affinity-dependent sequential recruitment requires crystallographic validation.
